response:

- Reconciliation build requires Karim from platform for two weeks to help with ledger integration.
- Mobile receipt-capture will ship v1 without bulk-select (descoped to avoid further strain on the reconciliation-stretched eng team); bulk-select goes on the roadmap as a fast-follow.
- OCR confidence indicator prominence issue from user testing is noted but not resolved with a decision in this meeting.
- Vendor payout SLA: target is 48-hour p95 from invoice approval (current p95 is 71 hours); plan is to cut the ACH batching window from 12 hours to 4 (eng) and add a second west-coast-shift approver (ops) to hit the target by mid-Q3, contingent on a trade-off analysis and SRE sign-off on added monitoring load.
- Audit-log retention update is confirmed pushed to Q4, per agreement with Legal.
- Internal admin-tool refresh remains with the intern crew, unchanged.
- On-call rotation proposal requested in response to HR-flagged bug-bash burnout on engineering.

- Marcus: Perform ACH batching window trade-off analysis (with SRE sign-off) and bring it back, by next week.
